item.title: Trump at South Florida rally revives the idea of military intervention in Cuba after Iran
item.description: President Donald Trump has said U.S. warships returning from Iran could stop in Cuba. It's his latest suggestion of taking an interventionist approach to the nearby country.

item.title: New York state woman charged with voting illegally says she recently learned she wasn’t a citizen
item.description: A Syracuse, New York, woman has been charged with voting illegally in one of the latest arrests touted by the Trump administration as it hunts for noncitizen voters ahead of the midterm elections.

item.title: Kenya announces 2nd Ebola death, a close relative of the first patient
item.description: Kenya’s Health Ministry has announced the country's second Ebola death. A 65-year-old woman, a close relative of the first patient, died after developing symptoms while in quarantine.

item.title: Knicks say using championship rings in an email to fool employees was an 'unfortunate mistake'
item.description: Madison Square Garden says an email that led employees to believe they were selecting a Knicks championship ring but instead was a phishing attempt was an “unfortunate mistake.”

item.title: Jury convicts man of rape, murder 14 years after UNC student’s death
item.description: A man accused of killing a North Carolina college student 14 years ago has been convicted of first-degree murder, rape and other charges.
